info.name: Abcuro Content API (WordPress REST) Search API

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to items of an object type.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Limit results to items of one or more object subtypes.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (sparse fieldsets).

params.name: _embed
params.description: Embed linked resources (author, featured media, terms) inline under _embedded.

items.docs: Full-text search across every searchable content type, including publications, people, investors and press releases.
